import pathlib,hashlib,json,difflib
p=pathlib.Path('udt_goce_product_eligibility_audit_2026-09-07/DECISION_BRIEF.md')
current=p.read_text()
new="PE1 and this brief: VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEATS at their document-only scope.\nFinal premise, preservation and review checks passed. No scientific banking or data fit.\n"
old="PE1 scientific review: VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEATS at its document-only scope;\nfinal packaging review/checks pending. No scientific banking or data fit.\n"
assert current.count(new)==1
previous=current.replace(new,old)
assert hashlib.sha256(previous.encode()).hexdigest()=='e2d434397673475678ca4043d4d6ef95393529aa1903dfb8837abe3dbe4f15df'
